chunks: And with the preceding chain of narration from Ali ibn Mahzyar, from Ali ibn Hadid, from Murazim, who said: Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, said:

"Always pray in the mosques, and be good neighbours to the people, and uphold testimony, and attend funerals. For surely you cannot do without the people! No one can live his life without needing the people! As for us, we attend their funerals, and it is only fitting for you to do as the one you follow does. And people are inevitably dependent upon each other as long as they remain in this state, until that appointed time comes; then every community will retire to join those of their inclinations."

Then he said: "Always offer your prayers properly, and work for your hereafter, and make the best choice for yourselves. For indeed, a man may be shrewd in worldly matters, and it is said: 'How wise is so-and-so!' But truly, the sagacious one is he who is wise regarding the hereafter."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about the importance of community and the hereafter?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) exhorts his followers to maintain strong social bonds by praying in mosques, being good neighbours, giving testimony, and attending funerals, emphasizing that no one can live independently of others. He then advises them to prioritize the hereafter over worldly shrewdness, teaching that true wisdom lies in preparing for the next life. This teaching was addressed to the Shia community during a period of taqiyyah, when the Imam encouraged active participation in the broader Muslim community.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 12. And with the preceding chains of narration from ‘Ali ibn Mahzyar, from ‘Ali ibn Hadeed, from Marazim, who reported that: Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon both, said:

"Always pray in the mosques and be good neighbours to the people. And always uphold your trust and covenants and attend the funerals. For surely, you cannot do without the people! No man’s life can go on without needing the people! As for us, we attend their funerals, and it is for you to do the way your leaders do! People have no alternative but to remain dependent upon each other till death does them apart; then every community will retire to join those they love."

Then he said: "Always offer your prayers properly and work for your next world and make the best choice for yourselves. Indeed, a man may be sagacious in his worldly affairs, till it is said: ’How wise is so and so!’ But surely, the sagacious is one who is wise about the hereafter."
